issues.quote: Cash generation kept pace: operating cash flow reached $9.1 billion in fiscal 2022, up from $5.8 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: Operating cash flow grew about 56% while net income grew about 125%, so cash generation did not keep pace. Operating cash flow fell from above net income in FY21 to below it in FY22.
The weaker conversion of net income into operating cash flow in FY22 does not support a claim of improving earnings quality.

data.summary: All the figures (revenue, net income, operating cash flow, cash, total assets, total liabilities) and the growth rates match NVIDIA's reported FY2022 results. The wording that cash generation "kept pace" and that earnings quality is "improving" is misleading, because operating cash flow grew far more slowly than net income.
